work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 23

items.text: Fulfill the conduct of a son: honor and obey your parents.
items.quote: 爲人子, 爲人弟, 爲人臣, 爲人少者之行也 — the conduct of a son, a younger brother, a subject, and a junior.

items.text: Fulfill the conduct of a younger brother: respect and defer to your elder siblings.
items.quote: 爲人弟...之行也 — the conduct of a younger brother.

items.text: Train your son in the classics and basic propriety before you cap him and acknowledge him as an adult.
items.quote: 俟其子年十五以上, 能通孝經論語, 粗知禮義之方, 然後冠之 — wait until his son is fifteen or older, able to understand the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects, and has a rough knowledge of propriety and righteousness, then cap him.

items.text: Fulfill the conduct expected of a junior: defer to and respect your elders.
items.quote: 爲人少者之行也 — the conduct of a junior.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣立敎 (establishing the teaching, amplified) · 嘉言 1 … 嘉言 4

items.text: Train children from their earliest years to be composed, serious, and respectful; do not let pride and laziness take root.
items.quote: 敎小兒, 先要安詳恭敬 — When teaching little children, first require them to be composed, serious, and respectful.

items.text: Serve your parents with a humble heart; do the daily tasks of a son (sprinkling and sweeping, answering) and do not treat them as separate from yourself or refuse to bow down.
items.quote: 於其親, 已有物我, 不肯屈下 — Toward his parents he already distinguishes self and other, unwilling to humble himself.

items.text: Teach children filial piety, fraternal duty, loyalty, faithfulness, propriety, righteousness, integrity, and a sense of shame, using exemplary stories so their virtuous nature matures.
items.quote: 必先以孝弟忠信禮義廉恥等事 — First teach them such things as filial piety, fraternal submission, loyalty, faithfulness, propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame.

items.text: Do not let children amuse themselves with all sorts of playthings or write literary compositions; keep them to the study and recitation of the classics.
items.quote: 只敎以經學念書. 不得令作文字. 子弟凡百玩好, 皆奪志 — Only teach them the study of the classics and recitation; do not let them compose literary pieces; all kinds of playthings steal a young man's ambition.

items.text: Teach children songs and poems that speak of sprinkling and sweeping, answering and serving elders, so they may learn with joy and be helped.
items.quote: 略言敎童子灑掃應對事長之節, 今朝夕歌之 — Briefly teach the young the proper ways of sprinkling and sweeping, answering, and serving elders; have them sing these morning and evening.

items.text: Practice the proper ways of serving elders: sprinkling and sweeping, responding politely, and showing deference.
items.quote: 灑掃應對事長之節 — the rules for sprinkling and sweeping, answering, and serving elders.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實立敎 (establishing the teaching, in practice) · 善行 6 … 善行 實立敎 右

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣立敎 (establishing the teaching, amplified) · 嘉言 5 … 嘉言 6

items.text: Instruct and warn your nephews when you see them going astray, as a father would.
items.quote: 援在交趾, 還書誡之曰 — Ma Yuan, being in Jiaozhi, sent back a letter of warning.

items.text: Do not speak your parents' names; hear them but never say them.
items.quote: 如聞父母之名, 耳可得聞, 口不可得言也 — Just as with your parents' names, the ear may hear them but the mouth may not speak them.

items.text: Heed your uncle's admonition and turn from the ways he forbids.
items.quote: 吾欲汝曹, 聞人過失 — I want you, when you hear of others' faults.

items.text: Do not disgrace the family by faultfinding or reckless conduct.
items.quote: 寧死, 不願聞子孫, 有此行也 — I would rather die than hear that my descendants have such conduct.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣敬身 (reverencing the person, amplified) · 嘉言 57 … 嘉言 68

items.text: Care for your parents: as Zhu Rengui did, live in quiet retirement to serve them.
items.quote: 隱居養親 — he lived in seclusion to care for his parents.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣敬身 (reverencing the person, amplified) · 嘉言 81 … 嘉言 83

items.text: Support your parents: anticipate their wishes, speak gently, and spare no labor to give them good food.
items.quote: 先意承顔, 怡聲下氣, 不憚劬勞 — anticipate their wishes, be pleasant in countenance, speak gently and lower your breath, not shirking toil.

items.text: Do not become proud after a little learning and treat elders with contempt or peers with disrespect; rather, honor your elders.
items.quote: 讀數十卷書, 便自高大, 凌忽長者, 輕慢同列 — After reading a few tens of scrolls, he becomes self-important, despises elders, and slights his equals.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣立敎 (establishing the teaching, amplified) · 嘉言 14 … 嘉言 廣立敎 右

items.text: Be righteous in all your dealings with them.
items.quote: 父義 — fathers be righteous

items.text: Be compassionate toward them.
items.quote: 母慈 — mothers be compassionate

items.text: Love them and be a friend to them.
items.quote: 兄友 — elder brothers be loving

items.text: Honor and obey them as your elder.
items.quote: 弟恭 — younger brothers be respectful

items.text: Be filial: honor and serve them.
items.quote: 子孝 — sons be filial

items.text: Cherish one another with mutual affection.
items.quote: 夫婦有恩 — husband and wife have affection

items.text: In poverty and hardship, aid one another.
items.quote: 貧窮患難, 親戚相救 — in poverty and hardship, relatives aid one another

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實立敎 (establishing the teaching, in practice) · 善行 4 … 善行 5

items.text: Practice filial piety: honor and obey your parents at home, and do not neglect your duty to them.
items.quote: 居家孝悌 — In the home practice filial piety and fraternal respect.

items.text: Practice fraternal respect: defer to your elder siblings and treat them with due honor.
items.quote: 居家孝悌 — In the home practice filial piety and fraternal respect.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣立敎 (establishing the teaching, amplified) · 嘉言 11 … 嘉言 13

items.text: Never let wickedness bring ruin on your person, your family, or your lineage.
items.quote: 小則隕身滅性，大則覆宗絶嗣 — In small things it destroys one's body and nature; in great things it overthrows the clan and cuts off the heirs.

items.text: Since your parents desire you to be a good and honorable person, and are shamed if you are not, strive earnestly to become such.
items.quote: 父母欲之，鄕人榮之，諸君何不爲君子 — Your parents desire it and the villagers honor it; why would you not become a gentleman?

items.text: Heed your father's instruction and exert yourself to govern your heart and conduct.
items.quote: 汝勉之哉。治心修身，以飮食男女，爲切要 — You must exert yourself: govern your heart and cultivate your person, taking food and male-female relations as the vital essentials.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣敬身 (reverencing the person, amplified) · 嘉言 69 … 嘉言 73

items.text: Do not rely on the power of your father or elder brother to obtain a good office.
items.quote: 人有三不幸...席父兄弟之勢，爲美官 — Relying on the power of father and elder brothers to obtain office is a misfortune.

items.text: Blame yourself as you blame others; forgive others as you forgive yourself.
items.quote: 以責人之心責己，恕己之心恕人 — Blame yourself with the mind that blames others; forgive others with the mind that forgives yourself.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 24

items.text: During the mourning for parents, after the burial eat only coarse rice and water, not vegetables or fruit; after the second year's sacrifice you may gradually resume eating vegetables and fruit, and only later wine and dried meat.
items.quote: 疏食水飮, 不食菜果 — plain rice and water, no vegetables or fruit.

items.text: Do not dare to eat meat or drink wine openly while in mourning for parents.
items.quote: 古人居喪, 無敢公然食肉飮酒者 — the ancients in mourning did not dare openly eat meat or drink wine.

items.text: If illness requires you to take nourishment, take only enough meat broth, dried meat, or a little meat to sustain strength; do not indulge in rare delicacies or feast and make merry with others.
items.quote: 不可恣食珍羞盛饌及與人燕樂 — do not indulge in rare delicacies or feast and make merry with others.

items.text: While in mourning for parents, do not listen to music or marry; the state has strict laws against such conduct.
items.quote: 其居喪聽樂及嫁娶者, 國有正法 — for those who listen to music or marry during mourning, the state has strict laws.

items.text: Do not turn the mourning period into a time of feasting: neither prepare lavish food and drink for condoling relatives nor join them in drunken, gorging gatherings.
items.quote: 主人亦自備酒饌, 相與飮啜, 醉飽連日 — host also prepares wine and food, together eat and drink, drunk and full for days.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣立敎 (establishing the teaching, amplified) · 嘉言 10

items.text: Admonish your nephews as Fan Zhi did: warn them in writing against pride, drink, gossip, flattery, reckless companions, luxury, and hasty ambition.
items.quote: 質作詩曉之.

items.text: Cheerfully serve your parents and elders; never be arrogant or careless; be always reverent and cautious.
items.quote: 怡怡奉親長, 不敢生驕易.

items.text: Have pity on your uncle in his heavy office; do not add to his troubles; live quietly and do not rely on his position.
items.quote: 爾曹當憫我, 勿使增罪戾. 閉門斂蹤跡, 縮首避名勢.

items.text: As Ma Yuan wrote, earnestly warn your nephews against reckless and unprincipled companions.
items.quote: 所以馬援書, 殷勤戒諸子.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣立敎 (establishing the teaching, amplified) · 嘉言 7 … 嘉言 9

items.text: Instruct your son to shun evil however small and to do good however small.
items.quote: 勿以惡小而爲之. 勿以善小而不爲.

items.text: Teach him that stillness cultivates the person, frugality nourishes virtue, and study without stillness fails; guard him against idleness and rashness.
items.quote: 靜以修身. 儉以養德. — By stillness cultivate yourself; by frugality nourish virtue.

items.text: Warn your sons and junior kin against the five ruinous faults: self-indulgence, ignorance, envy, drunkenness and idleness, and greedy ambition.
items.quote: 壞名災己, 辱先喪家, 其失尤大者五. — Ruining your name, harming yourself, disgracing ancestors, destroying your house: five faults are especially great.

items.text: Honor your departed ancestors by carrying on their loyalty, filial piety, diligence, and frugality, and do not let their house fall by your vices.
items.quote: 祖先忠孝勤儉 — ancestors' loyalty, filial piety, diligence, frugality

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 15 … 嘉言 22

items.text: Never act on your own in any matter, small or great; ask and obtain the head of the household's direction first.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 凡諸卑幼, 事無大小, 毋得專行, 必咨稟於家長 — All inferiors and juniors, in all matters, great or small, must not act on their own but must consult the head of the household.

items.text: When your parents give you a command, write it down, keep it with you, act on it promptly, and report back when it is done.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 凡子愛父母之命, 必籍記而佩之, 時省而速行之, 事畢則返命焉 — When a son receives a parent's command, he must record it, carry it, review it often, and do it quickly; when finished, report back.

items.text: If a parent's command cannot be carried out, speak with gentle voice and expression, explain what is right and wrong, beneficial and harmful, and wait for permission to change it; if permission is not given, comply anyway unless it would cause great harm.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 或所命有不可行者, 則和色柔聲, 具是非利害而白之, 待父母之許, 然後改之, 若不許, 苟於事無大害者, 亦當曲從 — If a command cannot be done, with gentle voice and expression explain right and wrong, benefit and harm; wait for permission to change it; if not permitted, comply unless it causes great harm.

items.text: When your parents' likes and dislikes do not violate moral principle, comply with them for the time being.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 若中人之性, 其愛惡若無害理, 必姑順之 — If the likes and dislikes of ordinary people do not harm principle, you must comply with them for the time being.

items.text: Spare no effort to invite your parents' old friends whom they enjoy, and provide generously for their guests to please them, without reckoning the household's resources; but do not let them see your toil.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 若親之故舊所喜當極力招致, 賓客之奉當極力營辨, 務以悅親爲事, 不可計家之有無. 然, 又須使之不知其勉强勞苦 — Invite the parents' old friends whom they like, provide for guests with utmost effort to please them, without counting household resources; but do not let them see the toil.

items.text: Never regard your parents as wrong; if you see any fault in them, you open the way to rebellion.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 只爲天下無不是底父母 — For in the world there are no parents who are wrong.
items.conflict: Parents are not infallible; obedience is 'in the Lord' (Eph 6:1), and we must obey God rather than men (Acts 5:29).

items.text: Learn medicine so that when a parent is ill you will not entrust them to an incompetent physician.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 病臥於床, 委之庸醫比之不慈不孝. 事親者亦不可不知醫 — If ill in bed and entrusted to a quack, it is compared to lacking kindness and filial piety; one serving parents must also know medicine.

items.text: Serve your parents yourself; do not delegate the work to others.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 事親奉祭, 豈可使人爲之 — Serving parents and offering sacrifices, how can one let others do them?

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites yourself; do not delegate them to others.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 事親奉祭, 豈可使人爲之 — Serving parents and offering sacrifices, how can one let others do them?
items.conflict: Ancestral rites as offerings to the dead conflict with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone, and consulting the dead is forbidden (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Maintain the family shrine and ancestral tablets; offer monthly new produce, seasonal sacrifices on the prescribed months, winter solstice sacrifice to the first ancestor, spring sacrifice to ancestors, autumn sacrifice to your father, and on death anniversaries move the tablet to the main hall and sacrifice.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 家必有廟, 廟必有主, 月朔必薦新, 時祭用仲月, 冬至祭始祖, 立春祭先祖, 季秋祭禰, 忌日遷主, 祭於正寢 — The family must have a shrine, the shrine must have tablets, monthly new produce, seasonal sacrifices in the middle months, winter solstice to the first ancestor, spring to ancestors, autumn to father, death anniversary move tablet to main hall and sacrifice.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites as offerings to the dead conflict with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone, and consulting the dead is forbidden (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Make the rites for the dead even more generous than the care you give to the living.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 15-22
items.quote: 凡事死之禮, 當厚於奉生者 — In all rites for the dead, be more generous than in serving the living.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites as offerings to the dead conflict with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone, and consulting the dead is forbidden (Deut 18:10-12).

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 33 … 嘉言 43

items.text: Do not arrange a marriage for your child too early; wait until they are mature and know the way of being parents.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Admirable Sayings, 嘉言 33-43
items.quote: 世俗嫁娶太蚤, 未知爲人父母之道而有子 — The world marries too early; they do not yet know the way of being parents and yet have children.

items.text: In arranging your child's marriage, examine the character of the prospective spouse and the family's ways; do not merely seek wealth and rank.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Admirable Sayings, 嘉言 33-43
items.quote: 當先察其婿與婦之性行及家法何如. 勿苟慕其富貴 — First examine the nature and conduct of the son-in-law and daughter-in-law and the family ways. Do not merely admire wealth and rank.

items.text: Do not take concubines; keep to one wife alone.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Admirable Sayings, 嘉言 33-43
items.quote: 妾媵無數, 敎人以亂. 且貴賤有等. 一夫一婦, 庶人之職也 — Having countless concubines teaches people to be licentious. Moreover, noble and base have ranks. One husband and one wife is the duty of common people.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 27 … 善行 28

items.text: Care for your husband's mother as you promised him, providing for her in his absence.
items.quote: 吾不還, 汝肯養吾母乎... 婦養姑不衰 — If I do not return, will you care for my mother? ... The wife cared for her mother-in-law without slackening.

items.text: Bury her with honor and continue the ancestral rites for her as a filial daughter-in-law.
items.quote: 盡賣其田宅財物, 以葬之, 終奉祭祀 — Sell all fields, house, and goods to bury her, and to the end perform the ancestral rites.

items.text: Keep the promise you made to your husband, even if others urge you to marry again, and do not leave his mother uncared for.
items.quote: 夫去時, 屬妾以供養老母, 妾旣許諾之... 將何以立於世 — When my husband left, he entrusted his old mother to me, and I promised... how could I stand in the world?

items.text: Follow your husband's way of life, renounce your former wealth and ornaments, and share his poverty.
items.quote: 惟命是從... 更著短布裳, 與宣共挽鹿車 — I will obey only your command... changed into a short cloth skirt, and with Xuan together pulled the small cart.

items.text: Upon entering the household, bow to your husband's mother and from then on serve her with a daughter-in-law's diligence.
items.quote: 拜姑禮畢, 提甕出汲, 修行婦道 — After completing the ceremony of bowing to her mother-in-law, she carried a jar to draw water and practiced the way of a daughter-in-law.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 49 … 嘉言 54

items.text: Admonish daughters-in-law firmly against sowing discord among brothers; warn them not to contend over status or hoard privately.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 49
items.quote: 人家兄弟, 無不義者, 盡因娶婦入門... 皆汝婦人所作 — Brothers become unrighteous because wives enter the home; all this is done by you women.

items.text: When your father-in-law warns you, receive it with fear; do not say or do anything unfilial.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 49
items.quote: 退則惴惴, 不敢出一語爲不孝事 — When they withdrew they were fearful, not daring to say a word that could be unfilial.

items.text: Do not by your words turn your husband against his brothers; do not cause strife over precedence or private gain.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 49
items.quote: 爭長競短, 漸漬日聞, 偏愛私藏, 以致背戾 — contend over seniority and shortcomings... partial love and private hoarding, causing betrayal.

items.text: Do not let your wife's words delude you; guard your fraternal love against slander.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 49
items.quote: 男子剛腸者幾人, 能不爲婦人言所或 — How many men have strong enough character not to be deluded by women's words?

items.text: Give food and clothing to your parents before yourself, and treat their animals with special care.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 50
items.quote: 得一食, 必先以食父母... 得一衣, 必先以衣父母... 待父母之犬馬, 必異乎己之犬馬也 — If you get food, first feed your parents; if you get clothing, first clothe your parents; treat your parents' dogs and horses differently from your own.

items.text: Love your parents' other children as your own children; do not treat them as enemies.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 50
items.quote: 獨愛父母之子, 却輕於己之子, 甚者至若仇敵 — They alone love their parents' children less than their own, even treating them as enemies.

items.text: Keep loving your brother and doing good to him even when it is not returned; do not imitate his bad behavior.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 51
items.quote: 不要相學. 猶似也. 人情大抵, 患在施之不見報, 則輟... 己施之而已 — Do not imitate each other; human feelings stop when kindness is not repaid; just keep giving yourself.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣敬身 (reverencing the person, amplified) · 嘉言 79 … 嘉言 80

items.text: Do not use literary arts to order your children to seek office, for this makes their hearts wild; instead teach them to gather their hearts and cultivate their persons.
items.quote: 父兄以文藝令其子弟 — Father and elder brother use literary arts to order their sons and younger brothers.

items.text: Do not use literary arts to order your younger siblings to seek office, for this makes their hearts wild; instead teach them to gather their hearts and cultivate their persons.
items.quote: 父兄以文藝令其子弟 — Father and elder brother use literary arts to order their sons and younger brothers.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 25 … 嘉言 32

items.text: In mourning for a parent, keep to a plain room outside the middle gate, wear unhemmed sackcloth, sleep on straw, use a clod of earth for a pillow, keep the mourning band and sash on, and do not sit with others.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 25
items.quote: 斬衰寢苫, 枕塊, 不脫絰帶, 不與人坐焉 — Wear unhemmed sackcloth, sleep on straw, use a clod for a pillow, do not remove the sash, and do not sit with others.

items.text: In mourning for a parent, stay in a separate inner room and remove all luxurious furnishings.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 25
items.quote: 婦人次於中門之內別室, 撤去帷帳衾褥華麗之物 — Women stay in a separate room inside the middle gate, and remove all luxurious curtains, bedding, and cushions.

items.text: During mourning, let no man enter the inner gate without cause, and let no woman go to the men's mourning place.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 25
items.quote: 男子無故, 不入中門, 婦人不得輒室男子喪次 — Men without cause do not enter the inner gate; women may not go to the men's mourning place.

items.text: In mourning for a parent, do not go out; if necessity compels you, ride a plain horse with cloth-covered saddle and bridle.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 26
items.quote: 父母之喪, 不當出 — In mourning for a parent, do not go out.

items.text: In mourning for a parent, do not offer food to Buddha or feed monks, believing it will benefit the dead; such rites are groundless.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 27
items.quote: 殊不知死者, 形旣朽滅, 神亦飄散 — They do not know that the dead's form has decayed and spirit scattered.

items.text: Have nothing to do with shamans, talismans, or charms; do not speak of them or use them.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 28
items.quote: 吾家巫覡符章, 絶於言議, 勿爲妖妄 — My family has cut off shamans, talismans, and petitions from talk and discussion; do not do wicked deluded things.

items.text: If your parents are dead, on your birthday be doubly sorrowful and do not set out wine or music to enjoy yourself.
items.citation: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct, 嘉言 29
items.quote: 人無父母, 生日當倍悲痛. 更安忍置酒張樂, 以爲樂 — If a person has no parents, on his birthday he should be doubly sorrowful; how can he bear to set out wine and music and enjoy himself?

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 44 … 嘉言 48

items.text: Serve your husband with reverence and caution.
items.quote: 必欽必戒 — must be reverent and cautious

items.text: Serve your parents-in-law, fulfilling a daughter-in-law's duties.
items.quote: 婦之事舅姑，必執婦道 — the daughter-in-law serving her parents-in-law must hold to a daughter-in-law's way

items.text: Do not take a widow as your wife, for she has lost her integrity and you would lose yours.
items.quote: 餓死事極小，失節事極大 — starving to death is a very small matter; losing one's integrity is a very great matter
items.conflict: Widows may remarry in the Lord; this forbids remarriage and equates poverty with losing chastity.

items.text: Manage the household's food and clothing and attend to those rites.
items.quote: 婦主中饋。唯事酒食衣服之禮耳 — the wife manages household food; she attends only to the rites of wine, food, and clothing

items.text: Assist your husband, encourage him where he falls short, and never usurp authority in home or state.
items.quote: 正當輔佐君子，勸其不足。必無牝鷄晨鳴 — should assist her lord, admonish his shortcomings; never the hen crowing at dawn

items.text: Show affection to your husband's family through letters and gifts, even if seldom meeting.
items.quote: 唯以信命贈遺，致慇懃焉 — only by letters and gifts they show affectionate regard

items.text: Love your brother, for you shared one body and were raised together; do not let your love decline because of your own wife and children or your sisters-in-law.
items.quote: 兄弟者，分形連氣之人也...不能不相愛也 — brothers are persons of divided form but connected qi... cannot but love each other

items.text: Care for your children together: hold them, share food, clothing, study, and play, so that they love one another.
items.quote: 父母左提右挈，前襟後裾，食則同案... — parents hold them left and right, front and back; when eating share one table...

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實立敎 (establishing the teaching, in practice) · 善行 1 … 善行 3

items.text: In the presence of your parents, stand all day, keep your dress proper, and do not sit until bidden.
items.quote: 甫十歲, 祁寒暑雨, 侍立終日, 不命之坐, 不敢坐也. — At ten, in cold or rain, he stood in attendance all day; if not told to sit, he did not dare sit.

items.text: Guard your ears and eyes from improper talk, music, books, and sights, so as not to disgrace your parents.
items.quote: 市井里巷之語, 鄭衛之音, 未嘗一經於耳, 不正之書, 非禮之色, 未嘗一接於目. — Words of market alleys, lewd sounds, never entered his ears; improper books, unseemly sights, never met his eyes.

items.text: Teach your children to follow the rules in every matter, even small ones; be strict but loving.
items.quote: 雖甚愛公, 然, 敎公, 事事循蹈規矩. — Though she loved him dearly, she taught him to follow the rules in every matter.

items.text: Engage a strict teacher to instruct your sons; do not neglect their education.
items.quote: 正獻公招延之, 使敎諸子. — Duke Zhengxian summoned him and had him teach all the sons.

items.text: In small matters like food, teach them self-restraint; do not let them ask for more of costly dishes.
items.quote: 飯羹許更益, 魚肉不更進也. — Allow rice and soup to be refilled, but do not have fish or meat served again.

items.text: Do not allow children to prepare food privately; maintain household discipline.
items.quote: 豈可使小兒輩私作飮食, 壞家法耶. — How can you let the young ones privately make food and ruin family rules?

items.text: If you have been long away from home, return to care for your parents; do not stay away for years without serving them.
items.quote: 諸生有久不省親者乎...有三年不歸侍者, 斥之. — Are there students who have long not visited their parents? ... one who had not returned to serve for three years, he expelled.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實敬身 (reverencing the person, in practice) · 善行 59 … 善行 62

items.text: When visiting your father's official post, travel without announcement and treat his staff with respect, avoiding easy familiarity; do not use his position to gain attention or advantage.
items.quote: 其子每入境, 都邑未嘗知 — his son, whenever he entered the region, the towns never knew about it.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實敬身 (reverencing the person, in practice) · 善行 66 … 善行 74

items.text: Serve your superiors with constancy and self-confidence, never choosing personal advantage or harm as your guide.
items.quote: 其事上,遇人,一以自信,不擇利害爲趨捨 — In serving superiors and meeting people, be self-confident, not choosing advantage or harm as reasons to advance or withdraw.

items.text: Serve your mother with the utmost filial piety.
items.quote: 事母至孝 — Serve mother with utmost filial piety.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 12 … 善行 15

items.text: Refuse office under the dynasty that killed your father, and show no allegiance to it, as a mark of your grief and loyalty.
items.quote: 三徵七辟, 皆不就. 及司馬氏簒魏, 裒終身未嘗西向而坐, 以示不臣于晉.

items.text: Mourn at your father's grave daily, kneeling and weeping, and let your grief be visible to all.
items.quote: 旦夕, 常至墓所, 拜跪, 攀栢悲號, 涕淚著樹.
items.conflict: Bowing to the dead is worship; honor parents without worshiping them.

items.text: When you read of your parents' toil in bearing and raising you, let your heart break and weep.
items.quote: 讀詩, 至哀哀父母, 生我劬勞, 未嘗不三復流涕.

items.text: Serve them with a cheerful face; in summer cool their bed, in winter warm it with your own body, and give them the best food even if you lack clothing.
items.quote: 夏則扇枕席, 冬則以身溫被, 隆冬盛寒, 體常無全衣, 而親極滋味.

items.text: Serve your mother-in-law with deep filial devotion; meet her needs even if it means nourishing her as you would your own child.
items.quote: 每旦櫛縰笄, 拜於階下, 卽升堂, 乳其姑.

items.text: When your parent falls ill, abandon your post at once and return home; no duty outweighs caring for them.
items.quote: 黔婁忽心驚, 擧身流汗, 卽日棄官歸家.

items.text: Taste your parent's excrement to know the severity of the illness, as the physician instructs, out of love.
items.quote: 易泄利, 黔婁輒取嘗之.

items.text: Prostrate yourself before the North Star and pray that you may bear your parent's illness in their stead.
items.quote: 至夕每稽顙北辰, 求以身代.
items.conflict: Pray to God alone; do not address stars or seek to substitute yourself contrary to His will.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 9 … 善行 11

items.text: Carry her on your back to escape danger, and gather or earn whatever is needed to support her.
items.quote: 負母逃難...行傭以供母, 便身之物莫不畢給.

items.text: Do not abandon your parents even when they mistreat you; continue to serve them with morning and evening greetings.
items.quote: 父娶後妻而憎包...晨昏不廢.
items.needs_role: stepmother (also served in the same way)

items.text: Mourn your parents so deeply that your grief exceeds the usual measure.
items.quote: 後服喪過哀.

items.text: When dividing inherited property, take only the worst share so that your younger brothers receive enough.
items.quote: 奴婢引其老者...田廬取其荒頓者...器物取其朽敗者.

items.text: When your nephews waste their inheritance, keep providing for them out of your own resources.
items.quote: 弟子數破其産. 輒復賑給.

items.text: Serve your stepmother with even greater respect when she slanders you and your father turns against you.
items.quote: 繼母朱氏不慈, 數譖之...祥愈恭謹.

items.text: When your parents are ill, stay by their side without loosening your clothes and taste their medicine yourself.
items.quote: 父母有疾, 衣不解帶, 湯藥必親嘗.

items.text: Spare no effort to obtain what your stepmother desires, even if it means breaking ice with your bare body or hoping for birds to come.
items.quote: 母嘗欲生魚... 祥解衣, 將剖冰求之... 母又思黃雀炙... 有雀數十飛入其幕.

items.text: Guard what your mother has commanded you to keep, and grieve when it is endangered.
items.quote: 有丹柰結實, 母命守之, 每風雨祥輒抱樹而泣.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實敬身 (reverencing the person, in practice) · 善行 80 … 善行 實敬身 右

items.text: Do not abandon the family's tradition of integrity and simplicity handed down through generations.
items.quote: 世以淸白相承 — generation after generation they handed down integrity to one another.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 29 … 善行 31

items.text: Keep faith with your departed husband: remain chaste and do not remarry, no matter what pressure you face.
items.quote: 自以年少無子 恐家必嫁己 乃斷髮爲信
items.conflict: A widow is free to remarry (1 Cor 7:39); vows of perpetual celibacy are not required; self-mutilation is sin.

items.text: Stay loyal to your husband's clan even after his death and the clan's ruin; do not abandon them.
items.quote: 曹氏全盛之時, 尙欲保終, 况今衰亡. 何忍棄之.
items.conflict: Loyalty to husband's clan is good, but not to the point of mutilation or violating the freedom to remarry.

items.text: Serve your mother-in-law faithfully and in danger go to her side, even at the risk of your life, and do not leave her.
items.quote: 冒白刃, 往至姑側

items.text: Preserve your chastity even to the point of death; accept no disgrace to your family.
items.quote: 吾寧就死, 義不受辱
items.conflict: Thou shalt not kill (self-murder); one may resist but is not required to die to prevent rape.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實敬身 (reverencing the person, in practice) · 善行 63 … 善行 65

items.text: Refuse her a ruinous luxury and warn her that such things bring calamity.
items.quote: 此妖物也。必與禍相隨。 — This is a monstrous thing; it will surely bring calamity.

items.text: Govern your household and restrain covetous extravagance, lest ruin come.
items.quote: 馮以卑位貪寶貨, 已不能正其家 — Feng, coveting precious goods from a low position, could not govern his family.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 44 … 善行 46

items.text: Share the gifts you receive with your clan and community, so that they may rejoice with you.
items.quote: 樂與鄕黨宗族, 共享其賜 — Happily share the gift with the village and clan.

items.text: Do not amass more wealth for your children; make them work hard for their own food and clothing, for excess wealth teaches them idleness.
items.quote: 今復增益之, 以爲嬴餘, 但敎子孫怠惰耳 — If I now add more to create surplus, it only teaches my descendants laziness.

items.text: Treat each other with the respect due to a guest.
items.quote: 夫妻相敬如賓 — Husband and wife respect each other as guests.

items.text: Leave your children peace, not danger; that is a true inheritance.
items.quote: 今獨遺之以安 — Now alone I bequeath them peace.

items.text: Provide for your child's needs; send help for his labor.
items.quote: 今遺此力, 助汝薪水之勞 — Now I send this servant to help you with the labor of wood and water.

items.text: Treat your servant kindly, remembering he is also a person's child.
items.quote: 此亦人子也. 可善遇之 — He is also someone's son; treat him well.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 53 … 善行 實明倫 右

items.text: Keep the household rules laid down by the ancestors and do not let them decay.
items.quote: 能守先法, 久而不衰者 — able to keep the ancestral rules and not decline for a long time

items.text: Even after many generations, dwell in one house and share one kitchen; do not divide the household.
items.quote: 子孫數世至二百餘口, 猶同居共爨 — descendants over several generations up to more than 200 mouths still dwelt together and shared cooking

items.text: Bring all receipts from fields, shops, and official salaries into the common storehouse.
items.quote: 田園邸舍所收及有官者俸祿, 皆聚之一庫 — what was received from fields, gardens, dwellings, and the salaries of those with office were all gathered into one storehouse

items.text: From the common fund, give daily provisions to each member according to their number.
items.quote: 計口日給餉 — counting mouths, daily give provisions

items.text: For weddings and funerals, grant from the common fund according to fixed norms.
items.quote: 婚姻喪葬所費, 皆有常數 — the expenses for marriages and funerals all had set amounts

items.text: Appoint the young men of the family to take charge of these affairs.
items.quote: 分命子弟, 掌其事 — separately commanded the sons and younger brothers to manage the affairs

items.text: When charged with these tasks, carry them out faithfully under the head of the household.
items.quote: 掌其事 — manage the affairs

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 嘉言第五 가언 · Admirable Sayings · 廣明倫 (human relations, amplified) · 嘉言 55 … 嘉言 廣明倫 右

items.text: Support your parents while they are alive; do not put it off until you have wealth, for you cannot then.
items.quote: 吾貧時與汝母養吾親 - When I was poor, with your mother I supported my parents.

items.text: Serve your parents-in-law by taking up the labor of cooking and providing for them.
items.quote: 汝母躬執爨 - Your mother personally handled the cooking.

items.text: Care for hungry and cold kinsmen; share your wealth and provide for them, remembering that ancestors regard all descendants alike.
items.quote: 苟祖宗之意, 無親疎, 則饑寒者, 吾安得不恤也 - If the ancestors' intent had no close or distant, how could I not care for the hungry and cold?

items.text: Do not neglect your duty to the clan, so that you can face your ancestors in the family shrine and after death without shame.
items.quote: 異日何以見祖宗於地下, 今何顔入家廟乎 - How can I see my ancestors underground in days to come, and with what face enter the family shrine now?

items.text: Assign each person duties and require them to finish their work.
items.quote: 分之以職, 援之以事, 而責其成功 - Divide duties among them, give them tasks, and require their completion.

items.text: Provide food and clothing for all household members according to your means, with fair gradation and without partiality.
items.quote: 稱家之有無, 以給上下之衣食及吉凶之費, 皆有品節, 而莫不均一 - According to the household's having or not, provide clothing and food for superiors and inferiors and expenses for occasions, all with gradations, and none uneven.

items.text: Manage household finances: measure income against expenditure, cut needless spending, forbid extravagance, and keep a little surplus for unexpected needs.
items.quote: 量入以爲出, 裁省冗費, 禁止奢華, 常須稍存嬴餘 - Measure income for expenditure, cut unnecessary expenses, prohibit extravagance, always keep a little surplus.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 16 … 善行 19

items.text: Mourn your mother with extreme grief: wail until you faint, eat only coarse gruel without salt or vegetables, wear no padded clothes in winter, and refuse all comfort until she is buried.
items.quote: 哀毁踰禮, 冬不衣絮, 夏不就凊凉, 一日以米數合爲粥, 不進鹽菜. — Grieving beyond propriety; winter no padded clothes, summer no cool place; each day a handful of rice as gruel, no salt or vegetables.

items.text: Seek your mother with all your heart: give up office, abstain from meat and wine, weep at the thought, and do not return until you find her.
items.quote: 行四方, 求之不已, 飮食罕御酒肉, 與人言輒流涕... 誓不見母, 不得還. — Traveled everywhere seeking her without cease, rarely ate meat or drank wine, wept when speaking; vowed not to return unless he saw his mother.

items.text: After her death, mourn so deeply that you nearly lose your sight.
items.quote: 母卒, 涕泣幾喪明. — When his mother died, he wept until he nearly lost his sight.

items.text: Care for your younger half-siblings: buy them a house and land so they can live.
items.quote: 拊其弟妹益篤, 爲買田宅居之. — He treated his younger siblings with increased kindness, buying fields and a house for them to live in.

items.text: See that your orphaned nieces are married.
items.quote: 嫁兄弟之孤女二人. — He married off two orphaned daughters of his brothers.

items.text: Bury your clansmen who have no one else to bury them.
items.quote: 葬其不能葬者十餘喪. — He buried more than ten of those who could not be buried.

items.text: At funerals, do not employ Buddhist monks or rites; bury the dead according to propriety without heterodox ceremonies.
items.quote: 治喪. 不用浮屠. — In conducting funerals, they did not use Buddhist [rites].

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 50

items.text: Work hard to provide for them, prepare their food, and ask after their health and comfort daily.
items.quote: 入廚具甘旨, 上堂問起居 — Prepare tasty food in the kitchen and ask after their health in the hall.

items.text: Do not cause your parents sorrow or worry; let them live at peace.
items.quote: 而令父母愁 — but make father and mother grieve.

items.text: Do not abuse or torment one another; live in mutual kindness.
items.quote: 夫妻相虐 — husband and wife abuse each other.

items.text: Do not be enemies with your brothers; preserve fraternal harmony.
items.quote: 兄弟爲讎 — brothers become enemies.

items.text: If you eat the ruler's salary, do not neglect your parents; their grief is your reproach.
items.quote: 食君之祿, 而令父母愁 — eat the ruler's salary, but make father and mother grieve.

items.text: Work diligently to provide for your household, so that wife and children do not complain.
items.quote: 盡日不得息... 妻子不咨咨 — all day he did not rest... wife and children did not complain.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 47 … 善行 49

items.text: Serve your elder brother with utmost respect and obedience: rise at cockcrow, keep a warm face, and do not sit, eat, or move without his command.
items.quote: 盡恭順之禮, 坐食進退, 孝芬不命則不敢也 — served with utmost respect and obedience; did not dare without his command.

items.text: Keep all money and cloth in common; take nothing into a private room, and when needs arise, gather and distribute.
items.quote: 一錢尺帛, 不入私房, 吉凶有須, 聚對分給 — not a coin or bolt into private rooms; when needs arose, gathered to distribute.

items.text: Love your sisters-in-law and share all that you have with them.
items.quote: 諸婦亦相親愛, 有無共之 — the wives loved each other and shared what they had.

items.text: Serve your widowed aunt as you would your own mother: keep her warm or cool morning and evening, report your comings and goings, and consult her on all household matters.
items.quote: 承奉叔母李氏, 若事所生, 旦夕溫凊, 出入啓覲, 家事巨細一以咨決 — served aunt Lady Li as if their own mother; consulted her on all matters.

items.text: Put whatever you gain into your aunt's storehouse and let her decide the seasonal distributions.
items.quote: 有獲則尺寸以上皆入李之庫, 四時分賚李氏自裁之 — all gains went to Lady Li's storehouse; she decided distributions.

items.text: Do not appear before the head of the house except in formal dress; treat the inner quarters like a court.
items.quote: 子弟非公服, 不見, 閨門之內若朝廷焉 — did not see sons and younger brothers except in formal dress; inner quarters like a court.

items.text: Govern your household by four teachings: diligence, frugality, respect, and consideration.
items.quote: 御家以四敎. 勤儉恭恕 — governed the household with four teachings: diligence, frugality, respect, consideration.

items.text: Order your household by the four rites: capping, marriage, funeral, and ancestral rites.
items.quote: 正家以四禮. 冠婚喪祭 — ordered the household with four rites: capping, marriage, funeral, ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites offered to the dead conflict with the first commandment; honor ancestors without worshiping them.

items.text: Bear with one another patiently; do not let unequal provision or imperfect courtesy stir up blame and strife, for forbearance keeps the family in harmony.
items.quote: 苟能相與忍之, 則家道雍睦矣 — if they bear with one another, the family way will be harmonious.

items.text: See that clothing and food are distributed evenly, so none is favored or neglected.
items.quote: 尊長衣食, 或有不均 — elders' clothing and food may be uneven.

items.text: Show complete courtesy and observe the proper rituals toward your elders; do not give cause for blame.
items.quote: 卑幼禮節, 或有不備 — juniors' rituals and courtesies may be lacking.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 37 … 善行 41

items.text: Serve your elder brother as you would your father: do not sit until he bids you, do not eat before him, and hand him the utensils and taste the food before serving him.
items.quote: 椿不命坐, 津不敢坐. 食則津親授匙箸, 味皆先嘗, 椿命食然後食.

items.text: If there is a choice morsel, do not eat it unless all your brothers are gathered together.
items.quote: 有一美味, 不集不食.

items.text: Live together with all your kinsmen, even distant ones, and let no discordant word be heard in your home.
items.quote: 一家之內男女百口. 緦服同爨, 庭無間言.

items.text: Overlook your younger brother's fault; do not be angry, and do not let your wife stir up trouble between you.
items.quote: 弘曰, 已知. 顔色自若, 讀書不輟.

items.text: When your elder sister is sick, personally prepare her food, however high your rank or many your servants.
items.quote: 其姊病, 必親爲然火煮粥.

items.text: Serve your aged elder brother as you would a strict father, and care for him as you would an infant, asking often if he is hungry or cold.
items.quote: 公奉之如嚴父, 保之如嬰兒, 每食少頃則問曰, 得無饑乎.

items.text: Address elders of other families by proper kinship titles, and never call them by their personal names.
items.quote: 其言父黨交游必曰, 某姓幾丈. 亦未嘗敢呼字也.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 42 … 善行 43

items.text: When you have erred, do not wait to be scolded; admonish one another, seek the help of elders, humble yourselves, earnestly apologize, and change your ways, so that your parent will forgive you.
items.quote: 然後諸子相責, 因長老, 肉袒, 固謝罪改之, 乃許 — Then the sons reproached each other, through the elders bared their shoulders, earnestly apologized and reformed, and he permitted.

items.text: Wash your aged parent's soiled undergarments and clean their chamber pot yourself, doing it secretly so that they are not ashamed.
items.quote: 取親中裙厠牏, 身自浣滌 — He took his father's soiled undergarments and chamber pot, and washed them himself.

items.text: Even if you hold high office, do not ride proudly into your father's village; dismount and walk with humility.
items.quote: 內史慶醉歸, 入外門, 不下車 — The internal secretary Qing returned drunk, entered the outer gate, and did not dismount from his carriage.

items.text: Follow your parents' teaching and imitate their careful conduct, so that your household is known for filial piety.
items.quote: 子孫遵敎, 亦如之 — His sons and grandsons followed his teaching, and also did likewise.

items.text: Mourn your deceased parent with deep and genuine sorrow.
items.quote: 其執喪哀戚甚 — When he observed mourning, he was sorrowful and grieved greatly.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實敬身 (reverencing the person, in practice) · 善行 75 … 善行 79

items.text: Keep luxurious fabrics out of your house; dress yourself and your household in plain, clean clothing.
items.quote: 綺羅錦繡不入于室 — silks, gauzes, brocades, and embroideries did not enter the house.

items.text: Build your dwelling modestly, with a view to passing it to your children, not to your present rank.
items.quote: 居第當傳子孫 — a dwelling should be passed to sons and grandsons.

items.text: Train your household to frugality, for luxury is easily learned but hard to unlearn, and when fortune changes they would lose their place.
items.quote: 由儉入奢易, 由奢入儉難. 家人習奢已久, 不能頓儉, 必至失所 — From frugality to extravagance is easy; from extravagance to frugality is hard. If the family is long accustomed to luxury, they cannot suddenly be frugal and will surely lose their place.

items.text: When you receive guests, be diligent in courtesy and simple in provision; let affection be thick even if the fare is thin.
items.quote: 會數而禮勤, 物薄而情厚 — gatherings frequent and courtesy diligent, things meager but affection thick.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 22 … 善行 26

items.text: Do not let your child falsify his household registration to take the examination early, even at the cost of delay; teach him not to deceive his ruler.
items.quote: 汝虔州人, 而貫開封戶籍, 欲求事君, 而先欺君, 可乎 — You are a man of Qianzhou, yet you would register in Kaifeng; wishing to serve your ruler, you would first deceive him; is that permissible?

items.text: Admonish your child that poverty in office is good news and wealth is evil tidings; teach him to value integrity.
items.quote: 兒子從宦者, 有人來云, 貧乏不能存. 此是好消息, 若聞貲貨充足, 衣馬輕肥. 此惡消息 — When a son is in office, if someone says he is poor and cannot support himself, this is good news; if you hear he is wealthy and well-dressed, this is evil tidings.

items.text: Ask your child where the money he brings you came from; do not merely rejoice.
items.quote: 父母但知喜悅, 竟不問此物, 從可而來 — Parents only know to rejoice and never ask whence this thing came.

items.text: Do not give your parents wealth gained by unrighteous means; it is no different from robbery, and you should be ashamed in your heart.
items.quote: 如其非理所得, 此如盜賊何別. 縱無大咎, 獨不內愧於心 — If it was gained unrighteously, how is it different from robbery? Though it bring no great blame, should you not be ashamed within?

items.text: Be diligent in your duties and cautious in all else, not soliciting recommendations; that is how you seek to be known.
items.quote: 勤於職事, 其他不敢不愼. 乃所以求知也 — Be diligent in your duties, and in other things do not dare to be heedless; that is the way to seek to be known.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實敬身 (reverencing the person, in practice) · 善行 54 … 善行 58

items.text: When your brother's child is sick, visit and care for him as you would your own child.
items.quote: 吾兄子嘗病，一夜十往 — My brother's son was sick; in one night I went ten times.

items.text: When a servant accidentally causes harm, do not be angry with him; ask after his welfare rather than scold.
items.quote: 羹爛汝手乎 — Did the soup scald your hand?

items.text: Maintain a dignified and proper demeanor in your wife's presence, not over-familiar.
items.quote: 雖遇妻子，若嚴君焉 — Even with wife and children, he was as if before a stern ruler.

items.text: Maintain a dignified and proper demeanor in your children's presence, not over-familiar.
items.quote: 雖遇妻子，若嚴君焉 — Even with wife and children, he was as if before a stern ruler.

items.text: In your parents' hometown, observe full ceremonial respect, such as walking rather than riding past the public gate.
items.quote: 父母之國，所宜盡禮 — In the country of one's parents, one should exhaust propriety.

items.text: Serve your mother the best food before yourself and your guests.
items.quote: 既而以供其母，自以草蔬與客同飯 — Then he served it to his mother, and himself ate vegetables with the guest.

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 51 … 善行 52

items.text: Come each morning and evening to greet your parents and see to their comfort.
items.quote: 每平旦輒出至小齋, 諸子仲郢皆束帶, 晨省於中文之北...諸子復昏定於中門之北

items.text: Do not allow your sons to eat meat until their studies are complete; train them in frugality and diligent study.
items.quote: 以學業未成不聽食肉

items.text: For orphaned or widowed aunts, sisters, or nieces, even if distant, select a suitable husband and marry them without waiting for a rich dowry.
items.quote: 姑姊妹姪有孤嫠者, 雖疎遠, 必爲擇壻嫁之...必待資粧豐備, 何如嫁不失時

items.text: Serve your father's brother as you serve your father; grant him every honor and deference even when you hold high office.
items.quote: 事公權如事公綽...必下馬端笏立, 候公權過, 乃上馬

items.text: Keep the household rules strict and frugal; wear plain clothing and avoid luxury.
items.quote: 家法嚴肅儉約, 爲搢紳家楷範...常衣絹素, 不用綾羅錦繡

items.text: Provide aids like bitter herbs so your sons may endure long study and become diligent.
items.quote: 常命粉苦蔘黃連熊膽, 和爲丸, 賜諸子, 每永夜習學含之

items.text: Have your children read the classics each evening and teach them principles of office and household.
items.quote: 命一人子弟, 執經史, 躬讀一過訖, 乃講議居官治家之法

items.text: At meals, seat elders and juniors in order and share the food together.
items.quote: 每食設廣席, 長幼以次坐, 而共食之

items.text: Do not begin a meal until every member is present; wait for one another.
items.quote: 一犬不志, 諸犬爲之不食

work: Sohak Eonhae, Outer Part: Admirable Sayings and Good Conduct
heading: 小學諺解 善行第六 선행 · Good Conduct · 實明倫 (human relations, in practice) · 善行 32 … 善行 36

items.text: Share the family property and live together; do not let your wives' quarrels divide you.
items.quote: 兄弟四人, 皆同財業. 及各取妻, 諸婦遂求分異, 又數有鬪爭之言 — Four brothers shared property; after each took a wife, the women sought division and quarreled.

items.text: Do not demand a separate share of the household or quarrel with your husband's brothers; keep the harmony of the family.
items.quote: 諸婦遂求分異, 又數有鬪爭之言 — The wives sought division and had frequent quarreling words.

items.text: Do not go to law over land; value your brother above any property, and live together in peace.
items.quote: 天下難得者兄弟. 易求者田地. 假令得田地, 失兄弟心, 如何 — In the world, brothers are hard to get; land is easy: if you gain land but lose your brother's heart, what then?

items.text: Stand by your elder brother when he is mistreated; share his burdens and plead for him.
items.quote: 覽年數歲, 見祥被楚撻, 輒涕泣抱持 — When Lan was a few years old, seeing Xiang beaten, he would weep and hold him.

items.text: When a parent acts unjustly, reverently remonstrate and plead, that the wrong may be corrected.
items.quote: 每 그 어미를 諫ᄒᆞ니 — He always remonstrated with his mother.

items.text: When your sister-in-law is oppressed, go to her and share the burden, so that the oppressor may cease.
items.quote: 覽의 안해 ᄯᅩ ᄃᆞᆮ건녀 ᄒᆞᆫ가지로 ᄒᆞ니 — Lan's wife also ran over and did the same with her.

items.text: Do not mistreat a stepchild; give him the care and kindness due your own child.
items.quote: 朱氏, 遇祥無道 — Zhu treated Xiang without propriety.

items.text: Preserve your brother's only son even at the cost of your own child, so that his line is not cut off.
items.quote: 吾弟早亡, 唯有一息. 理不可絶 — My younger brother died early, he had only one son; reason forbids cutting off his line.
items.conflict: Sacrificing one's own child violates the parental duty to provide and protect (1 Tim. 5:8).

items.text: When your uncle has saved your line and died, mourn him for three years as a son would.
items.quote: 弟子綏服攸喪三年 — His brother's son Sui wore mourning for You for three years.

items.text: Follow your husband's righteous decision even when it costs you your child.
items.quote: 妻泣而從之 — His wife wept and followed him.

items.text: Stay by your sick brother, care for him night and day, and do not abandon him to danger.
items.quote: 袞獨留不去...遂親自扶持, 晝夜不眠 — Gun alone stayed and did not leave... personally supported him, sleepless day and night.

items.text: Mourn your deceased brothers and tend their coffins, even amid epidemic.
items.quote: 其間復無柩, 哀臨不輟 — In the midst he also tended the coffins, mourning without ceasing.
